VOICE_LISTENING_NOTICE: 🎙️ **I'm listening for my name in this channel.** Say "Amhra" (em-ha-ra) and then a command: "Amhra, pause", "Amhra, skip this song", "Amhra, play Bohemian Rhapsody". Only what you say right after my name is turned into text, and that text is only used to run the command. Anyone who turns on `/transcript` also has what they said shown in the chat. Anyone with Manage Server can turn this off with `/voicecommands`.
VOICE_LISTENING_NOTICE_CLIPS: 🎙️ **I'm listening for my name in this channel.** Say "Amhra" (em-ha-ra) and then a command: "Amhra, pause", "Amhra, skip this song", "Amhra, play Bohemian Rhapsody". Only what you say right after my name is turned into text, and that text is only used to run the command. To help me hear my name better, the second or so of audio in which I hear it is saved. Anyone who turns on `/transcript` also has what they said shown in the chat. Anyone with Manage Server can turn this off with `/voicecommands`.
VOICE_LISTENING_NEWCOMER: 🎙️ Heads up, {users}: voice commands are on here, so I listen for my name, "Amhra". See `/voicecommands`.
